baseline: Existing raw Markdown/CSV editor retained in the same build
candidate: Focused exact-paragraph and string-cell grid editing

cases.invariant: same exact saved v2 and untouched v1
cases.provenance: one warm automated browser sample, both text variants precomputed; raw uses full-document fill, not a human timing or proof that snippets cannot be edited in raw mode

cases.invariant: same canonical v2; leading zero IDs, decimal-comma and formula-like text remain unchanged
cases.provenance: one warm automated browser sample, complete raw replacement precomputed; field actions are not human productivity or provider quality

interpretation: The selected edits produce identical saved content with less replacement payload. Focused paragraph editing uses more scripted actions and is slower in this sample; no universal speed or effort win is claimed. A human could also edit snippets in raw mode.
not_measured: Human completion time and total effort
environment: Darwin arm64 shared development host; one warm scripted sample per path, precomputed inputs and other local tests active
